name: Priya Sharma
headline: Senior Product Manager | Mobile apps · Payments · Product discovery
summary: Product manager with 9 years across payments, edtech and retail tech, from analyst to senior PM. I built a mobile learning app from 0 to 250,000 monthly active learners and grew paid conversion from 2.1% to 3.4%. Open to relocation.

experience.title: Senior Product Manager
bullets: Ran weekly discovery calls with merchants and turned 40+ interviews into a 2-quarter roadmap.
Led a team of 6 engineers and 2 designers to rebuild the merchant checkout; payment success rate rose from 91% to 96%.
Launched a subscription billing product for 1,200 SMB merchants in 5 months.
Cut checkout drop-off from 38% to 24% by moving to a 2-step UPI and card flow.

experience.title: Product Manager
bullets: Built the mobile learning app (Android and iOS) from 0 to 250,000 monthly active learners.
Grew paid conversion from 2.1% to 3.4% with a free-trial redesign and A/B tests.
Worked with 3 engineering squads in Scrum and shipped every 2 weeks.

experience.title: Product Analyst
bullets: Built weekly sales dashboards in SQL and Metabase for 45 store managers.
Found a pricing error worth ₹18 lakh a quarter and helped the team fix it.

certifications: Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), Scrum Alliance, 2021
